neighbours.label: the word piece after a split-off initial L in names (L|ora, Lo|Ra, L|oren)
fire: The novelist Lora Smith signed books at the fair.
Our farm uses LoRa sensors to track soil moisture.

I met Lora at the conference in Denver.
The LoRa gateway forwards packets to the server.
The poet Loren Eiseley wrote about the natural world.
My aunt Lora bakes bread every Sunday.

quiet: The novelist Laura Smith signed books at the fair.

notes: Layer 1 spelling unit. Arabic 'ل|وح' (after lam) also fires. Probe: Lora 0.94, LoRa 0.86, Loren 0.42, Laura 0.00.
